Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer, LDH). There is also mild monocytosis, basophilia, and eosinophilia. INR is elevated, suggesting coagulopathy. Renal and liver function are preserved. SARS-CoV-2 RNA is negative. Findings are consistent with systemic inflammation, possible bone marrow suppression, and increased thrombotic risk; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
